claims: Ethan Lovett is a legacy character on General Hospital.
Ethan Lovett is played by Nathan Dean.
Nathan Dean was formerly known as Nathan Parsons.
Ethan Lovett is returning on April 17, 2026.
Ethan Lovett is the son of Luke Spencer and Holly Sutton.
Ethan Lovett is the half-brother of Lulu Spencer.
Ethan Lovett is a former con artist.
Ethan Lovett is returning to Port Charles.
Nathan Dean returns to the role after a six-year absence.
Nathan Dean's comeback is initially spurred by the passing of his on-screen father Anthony Geary.
Ethan Lovett initially tried to break into Luke’s bar the Haunted Star.
